review.assessment: The change refactors `word_frequencies` to iterate character-by-character rather than splitting on spaces, accumulating ASCII alphanumeric segments and lowercasing them to enforce case-insensitivity while treating all non-alphanumeric characters as delimiters. It handles arbitrary whitespace, punctuation, and consecutive separators robustly by finalizing words only when a boundary is encountered or at the end of the string. Finally, it sorts the collected frequencies vector by count descending and alphabetically ascending for ties before returning.
